steelman.best_case: For the only two quadratic functionals used, the nine positive coordinate atoms have raw second moment I/9, exactly the same as the explicit eighteen-atom plus/minus completion. Therefore they reproduce E[|curl|^2]=2/3, E[(div)^2]=1/3, and sqrt(2), and one may view them as sign-equivalence representatives.
steelman.why_not_sufficient: Neither source nor artifact says that signs were analytically quotiented because both observables are even. Read literally as the declared ensemble, the nine executed atoms have nonzero mean norm 1/3 and centered covariance eigenvalues {0,1/9 x 8}, not IID isotropic covariance. The existing test asserts only the target ratio and one correlated challenge, so the domain mismatch can false-green.
